expectedBehavior: Classify the first failure of the ordinary HelloIos project under the isolated candidate SDK before any workload installation.
observedBehavior: dotnet workload --info succeeded and reported no installed workload sets. dotnet build --no-restore exited 1 at Microsoft.NET.Sdk.ImportWorkloads.targets with NETSDK1147, requesting wasm-tools rather than ios.
limitations: No iOS manifest or packs are installed, so this is not an iOS-target evaluation.
The unexpected wasm-tools request requires comparison with a Mac reference build and an installed official manifest before diagnosis.
The binlog is local-only and has not been inspected with an iOS task graph.
nextDecision: Do not work around the wasm-tools request. Capture the Mac reference trace, then test the official and proposed manifest graph in a disposable home during M1.

commands.command: DOTNET_ROOT=<isolated-root> dotnet build tests/HelloIos/HelloIos.csproj -f net10.0-ios -r ios-arm64 -c Release --no-restore /bl:<local-binlog>
